snippet.title: Tokyo Wars Arcade
snippet.description:
Tokyo Wars is a one to eight players simultaneous tank battle (from the moment four booths are interconnected), both cooperative and competitive,which takes place on a large three-dimensional game arena. 
As the name suggests the battles are set and fought in Tokyo, the capital of Japan. Players, while waiting for the challenge to begin, must make two option choices: the first concerns the squadron they prefer (between “Green Force” and “White Force”), each consisting of twelve to twenty tanks,w hile the second one is one of the two areas of the city where they wish the clash to take place (between “Downtown” and “Bay Area”).

The only rule here is simply to go to war against the opponent, eliminating him within the 15 minutes of the match the tanks at his disposal that are scattered around the field. The radar shown on the top of the interface allows you to locate the positions of both sides.
The bar on the lower one, on the other hand, indicates the health status of one's tank, which is recharged to repair its damage from attacks by collecting a medical chest, which can be obtained after annihilating one of its tanks; if it runs out, the tank is destroyed and control automatically passes to another. 

The challenge is won by the squadron that has eliminated all the tanks, or the one that has survived to the end of the clash (once the last displayed 9 seconds have expired) by holding a greater number of tanks so far intact.
